title: Tests that build state with Codex discovery resolve the real user's ~/.termal/codex-home and would open its live state_5.sqlite
outcome: No test, focused or full, resolves, probes or opens anything under the real user's home (~/.termal, including codex-home/state_5.sqlite). Codex discovery in tests is pointed at a test-owned root or disabled.
acceptance: A note on current master identifies every test path that reaches resolve_termal_codex_discovery_root (src/codex_discovery.rs:163-170) or codex_home.rs:84 with the real HOME/USERPROFILE, and states whether the full gate launcher already isolates HOME while focused runs do not.

Those tests use a test-owned discovery root, by reusing the existing test temp-root helpers; no new mechanism is added if an existing one fits. A deterministic test proves that a test-constructed state never touches the real home, for example by asserting the resolved root is under the test temp root. Production resolution is unchanged.
The independent review pair finds no Medium or higher, and the full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
